# SCI-FLT v0.1 Stage A Decision Log

## FLT-A001 — Recovery Precedes New Science

- Date: `2026-08-30`
- Status: adopted program process
- Decision: complete package-specific prior-work and implementation recovery
  before new derivation or Stage B launch.

## FLT-A002 — Maintain The Stage A/Stage B Firewall

- Date: `2026-08-30`
- Status: adopted program process
- Decision: quarantine the internal dossier and exclude implementation,
  configuration, schema, audit, repair, test, validation, reduction, and
  performance material from future authorship.

## FLT-A003 — Current NOI Stage A Controls

- Date: `2026-08-30`
- Status: controlling boundary; no change to SCI-NOI
- Decision: use approved SCI-NOI Stage A ODQ-110A/B/C and ODQ-111 at the FLT
  boundary; exclude current SCI-NOI Stage B draft material.

## FLT-A004 — Propose A Deterministic/Inference Split

- Date: `2026-08-30`
- Status: coordinator recommendation; owner decision open
- Decision: propose `SCI-FLT-DET` and an `SCI-FLT-INF` tranche rather than one
  generic Stage B contract. This is not scientific authority until
  FLT-ODQ-101 is approved.

## FLT-A005 — Stop Before Stage B

- Date: `2026-08-30`
- Status: active gate
- Decision: complete and verify the Stage A recovery packet, then begin the
  owner walkthrough with FLT-ODQ-101. Do not commission implementation-blind
  authorship before the exact owner-decision object and packet are finalized.
